summary.text: Shirley Templo (listed by Ballotpedia as Shirley Ann Templo) is a Democratic member of the Hawaii House of Representatives, District 30, who took office on November 5, 2024, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. Her career experience includes work in city and state government and for nonprofits.

paragraphs.text: Templo succeeded Ernesto Ganaden in District 30.
For 2025-2026 she serves on the Economic Development and Technology and Finance committees and is vice chair of the Tourism committee.
She defeated Kekoa Kealoha and Faatea Faatea in the August 8, 2026 Democratic primary with 69.6 percent of the vote, and faces Republican Amanda Ybanez in the general election.
